title: Kenyan Fish Stew
description: A traditional Kenyan-inspired fish stew made with a blend of creamy coconut milk and spices. This hearty stew is perfect for a cold evening.

ingredients.name: Coconut milk
ingredients.notes: Full-fat coconut milk for a richer flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook until the onion is translucent.
Add curry powder and cumin. Cook for 1 minute.
Add fish pieces and cook until they are opaque.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let the stew cook for 10-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with poke (if using).
